subject: AWS Offer: hero + demo slate certification and co-sell checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: AWS Offer: hero + demo slate certification and co-sell checklist

Kimberly — looping you and the field team to align on the final hero blurb and the demo slate we intend to publish on AWS Marketplace for Acme Analytics (POC/early trial). Key asks below: 

- Quick review of hero-copy-v2.docx (attached). We need a 1-sentence hero and 3 benefit bullets that map to procurement questions (security, cost predictability, deployment modes).
- Approve demo-slate-v3.pdf (attached) — this will be used as the field demo checklist for initial co-sell engagements. Important: demos must show a hosted flow + a Dedicated latency comparison.
- Confirm we can ship the co-sell playbook to Acme next week (co-sell-playbook.xlsx attached) — Marissa / Sean, please confirm timeline and any missing legal/ops checks.

Timeline: would like sign-off by EOD Thu 10/15 to hit marketplace prep cycle. If there are changes that require procurement language, flag now and I can loop in legal.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Sales Lead, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123 | priyom@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: hero + demo slate certification and co-sell checklist

Thanks — quick pass below. Quoting your note for context: 

On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 09:12, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly — looping you and the field team to align on the final hero blurb and the demo slate we intend to publish on AWS Marketplace for Acme Analytics (POC/early trial).

Hero copy: good shape overall. Suggested edits (inline): 
- Hero sentence: "Enterprise-grade LLM inference with predictable cost and enterprise controls." -> tighten to: "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference for analytics teams." (shorter; calls out buyer).
- Benefit bullets: reorder to lead with "Cost predictability (batching + caching)" then "Security & VPC options" then "Dedicated throughput for production workloads."
- Add a short line under hero about "verifiable latency numbers" — we can link to a short benchmark section in the product page.

Demo slate: I left two spots that need owner assignment: (1) Dedicated latency microbenchmark, (2) Prefix caching walkthrough. If Sean can own latency numbers and Marissa can own the customer-facing script we can close this quickly. 

Co-sell playbook: see small redlines in the sheet — procurement checklist still needs the S3 data residency note (Acme cares about EU processing even though POC will run in us-east-1). We should add a short FAQ for field: "When to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted" with 3 bullet decision criteria.

I can make the hero edits and drop an updated file before EOD. Quick question: do we want the hero to mention "Redwood Optimize" or keep product names off the marketplace hero? My vote: keep concise and avoid product-branding in the primary hero; reserve for the feature section.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park | Head of Marketplace Content
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: hero + demo slate certification and co-sell checklist

Marissa / Sean — can you confirm owners and timelines so we can lock content?

Action items I propose: 
- Sean: own Dedicated latency microbenchmark. Deliverable: short table with p50/p95 for 512-token generation and note on GPU type. Due: 10/15 noon PT.
- Marissa: finalize customer-facing demo script and FAQ row in playbook. Due: 10/15 EOD PT.
- Kimberly: update hero with the tightened sentence and remove product-branding from the hero (Kim will share v2 by EOD).

Acme asks for a short procurement snippet about data residency. Can we add a one-line in the evidence section: "Customer data may be stored in customer VPC for Dedicated deployments; EU processing options available — contact solutions@redwood.com". If legal needs to reword, please flag.

I will present the packaged assets to Acme on 10/16 during their internal procurement review. If we miss EOD 10/15 we push to their next review week.

Thanks — Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: hero + demo slate certification and co-sell checklist

Quick confirm: I can finish the demo script and FAQ by EOD 10/15; I'll fold in the S3 data residency row and add a one-line decision checklist for Dedicated vs Hosted. Sean — can you confirm GPU and p95 numbers by 12:00 PT? If yes we'll bundle and send to Acme as "Marketplace preview" and include the evidence link.

Minimal edits on hero accepted; Kimberly, please share the final hero copy when ready.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. GTM Enablement Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: demo-slate-v3.pdf, hero-copy-v2.docx, co-sell-playbook.xlsx
